scientific_integrity: Analytic argument separately supported by deterministic finite quadrature/identity tests; overlap with an indexed three-sample beta-variance theorem was compared, but its full text was inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted iid-beta random-node affine least squares with an intercept and additive independent Gaussian observation errors. No extrapolation to weighted or conditioned samplers, polynomial degrees above one, or non-Gaussian noise; independent validation and publication-priority determination not performed.
title: Sharp moment budget for noisy affine fits under beta-distributed sampling
